author: reek
body: Station state management. The radio app has two decks, a mixer, a playlist queue, station metadata, and chat. The DJ controls everything; listeners receive the mixed audio output.

author: reek
body: Eight pre-configured stations covering a range of genres and frequencies. Presets are stored as parallel lists of names, genres, and frequencies in the app state. Selecting a preset updates the station metadata.

author: reek
body: Extends the per-deck 3-band EQ with two additional app-wide bands (low-mid and high-mid) for finer tonal control during broadcast.

author: reek
body: When the current track ends, automatically load and play the next track from the playlist queue.

author: reek
body: The bootable entry point lives in the sibling chapter RadioStationMain, so this library can be cited for its station and playlist logic without forcing a second `opening` on the citing program.
